sentences.en: And he can't wait.
sentences.zh: 他已经迫不及待了。

sentences.en: I'm sorry to tell you that we're going to stop here.
sentences.zh: 很抱歉地告诉大家，我们今天就到这里。

sentences.en: You will have to wait for this exit interview.
sentences.zh: 你们得等到下周才能看到这场离职面谈了。

sentences.en: It's how we will start out next week with Goodbye, Toby Part 2.
sentences.zh: 我们将以《再见，托比》下集开启下一周的节目。

sentences.en: It's so good.
sentences.zh: 太精彩了。

sentences.en: Oh, I loved this episode.
sentences.zh: 哦，我太喜欢这一集了。

sentences.en: hit you up with questions about this episode.
sentences.zh: 就这一集的各种问题向他们狂轰滥炸。

sentences.zh: 我太爱我们的办公室大家庭了。

sentences.en: They show up for us every week, you guys.
sentences.zh: 各位，他们每周都为我们全力以赴。

sentences.en: Big love to those folks.
sentences.zh: 向这些朋友们致以满满的爱。

sentences.en: They are really helping us get all the details of these episodes.
sentences.zh: 他们真的在帮我们理清这些剧集的方方面面。

sentences.en: And I love that we're recording it.
sentences.zh: 而且我很喜欢我们正在把这一切录下来。

sentences.en: We're going to have it.
sentences.zh: 我们会拥有的。

sentences.en: Goodbye, Toby.
sentences.zh: 再见，托比。

sentences.en: Part one is done.
sentences.zh: 第一部分完成了。

sentences.en: You know you're hot to trot for next week and we'll be here.
sentences.zh: 你知道你对下周充满期待，而我们也会在这里。

sentences.zh: 我们当然会的。

sentences.en: We'll see you then.
sentences.zh: 到时候见。
